body:
# Prepared-image contract reviewed; release domain/fit preparation

Reviewed CONTRACT-v1.md SHA2f0ea75272fdf43d90037aa91139a2a0084ecd648f5c271453dbb24cab0243fd and existing preservation boundary. Proceed with bounded full-domain enumeration/exact-reference/one- and two-pixel error alternatives, explicit coverage/world anchors/matrix translation/reflection, ID collision inventory and metadata/retained/temporary/peak RAM budgets under this freeze. Keep exact current compact path as each future control and both-order full race; no fresh generic runtime hook or timer/scheduler changes.45–90minute preparation estimate recorded; no Oryx request now.

Before implementing an approximate runtime policy, return actual domain/error/RAM/fit findings, proposed packed producer/consumer interface and your recommended bounded candidate. Approximate visual thresholds are still unaccepted; don't silently choose one as production. If exact fits and existing stock generation suffices, a separately staged exact candidate is within overall assigned scope after reporting pins/fit. Missing keys fail visibly; no hidden timed cache fills, generation or automatic fallback. Record INFO field support against the frozen firmware; no live runtime replacement for convenience. Human/publication and physical gates remain. Answer the Author's separate timing question from existing evidence as you are doing; this request doesn't displace their direct steering.
